defaults.storyBody:
The Fragrance Store was founded on a simple belief: that everyone in Sri Lanka deserves access to genuine, world-class perfumery — without compromise. Every bottle we offer is sourced from trusted distributors and inspected by hand.

Whether you are searching for an everyday signature or a rare niche composition, our consultants will guide you to the scent that feels unmistakably yours.
defaults.pillar1Text: Sealed, original bottles from verified sources.
defaults.pillar2Text: Carefully packed and delivered to your door.
defaults.pillar3Text: Expert guidance to find your signature.
defaults.notesTitle: Every fragrance tells a story *in three acts*
defaults.note1Text: The opening overture — bright, fleeting and vivid. Citrus, bergamot, pink pepper and aromatic herbs that draw you in.
defaults.note2Text: The soul of the perfume. Rose, jasmine, iris and spice unfold as the top notes fade, revealing its true character.
defaults.note3Text: The lasting memory. Oud, amber, vanilla, musk and precious woods that stay on skin long after you've left the room.
defaults.quote1: The only place in Colombo I trust for genuine perfumes. The consultation helped me find a scent I now can't live without.
defaults.quote2: Beautifully packaged, delivered to Kandy within two days, and completely authentic. A truly premium experience.
defaults.quote3: They sourced a rare niche fragrance I had been searching for for months. Exceptional service from start to finish.

pages.collectionsIntro: Every bottle in the house, arranged by character — or browse by the perfume houses we carry.
pages.seeEvery: See every bottle in the Signatures
pages.startsSoon: Sale prices appear here once the promotion starts.
pages.storyIntro: Founded in Colombo to make genuine, world-class perfumery easy to buy in Sri Lanka — with fair prices and people you can talk to.
pages.storyCtaTitle: Let us guide you to *your scent*
pages.artIntro: A perfume is composed like music — it opens, it deepens, and it lingers. Here is how to read one, and how to choose yours.
pages.concTitle: Parfum, EDP or EDT — *which to choose?*
pages.parfumText: The richest form: close to the skin, deep and long-lasting. A little goes a long way.
pages.edpText: The everyday luxury — full character with a generous trail. Our most popular choice.
pages.edtText: Lighter and brighter, ideal for warm Colombo days and the office.
pages.mistText: A soft veil of scent to refresh through the day.

info.when: Bank transfer orders are prepared once the payment reaches our account. Cash on delivery orders are prepared once we confirm them, usually by phone. You will receive the courier name and tracking number by email when your order is shipped.
info.codText: Please keep the exact amount ready for the courier.
info.codFee: A cash on delivery fee of {amount} applies.
info.returnsP1: For hygiene reasons, fragrances that have been opened or used cannot be returned.
info.damaged: If your parcel arrives damaged or you received the wrong item, please contact us within 48 hours of delivery with your order number and a photo. We will arrange a replacement or refund.
info.unopened: Unopened items in their original sealed packaging may be returned within 7 days of delivery. Delivery fees are not refundable.
info.refunds: Approved refunds are made by bank transfer to the account you provide, usually within 5 working days.
info.termsIntro: By placing an order with The Fragrance Store you agree to these terms.
info.prices: All prices are in Sri Lankan Rupees (LKR). The price you pay is the price shown when you place your order. Sale prices apply only while a promotion is live.
info.orders: We accept direct bank transfer and cash on delivery. Bank transfer orders are held until the payment reaches our account; unpaid orders may be cancelled after the payment deadline. Cash on delivery orders are confirmed by us before they are prepared.
info.stock: Stock is reserved when an order is confirmed. In the rare case an item sells out before your order is confirmed, we will contact you and offer an alternative or a full refund.
info.contact: Questions about these terms? Please <link>contact us</link>.
info.privacyIntro: We collect only what we need to deliver your orders and run our store.
info.collect1: Your name, mobile number, email and delivery address
info.collect3: What you add to your cart, so we can improve our range and help if you have trouble checking out
info.use: To process and deliver orders, contact you about them, and — only if you opt in — send you offers. We never sell your data.
info.delete: You can delete your account at any time from My account → Security. Your personal details are erased; order records are kept in anonymised form for our accounts.
